playstyle.identity: Gwen is an AP skirmisher who becomes untargetable in her mist. She shreds through tanks with her true damage snipping and sustains through fights.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive heals and deals percent health damage. Q snips, center snips deal more and apply passive. W creates mist (untargetable by enemies outside). E dashes and empowers autos with range/speed. R fires needles 3 times (must auto between). W to survive burst, Q for damage.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Gwen spikes at level 6 with her R burst and with Riftmaker for sustain. She's strong in extended fights and scales well.

passive.name: Thousand Cuts
passive.summary: Autos and Q deal bonus magic damage and heal Gwen based on damage dealt.
passive.details: Gwen's attacks deal bonus magic damage based on target's max health. She heals based on the damage dealt by this passive.

abilities.name: Snip Snip!
abilities.summary: Snip multiple times; center snips deal more and apply true damage.
abilities.details: Gwen snips at least twice, dealing magic damage. Enemies in the center take true damage and apply her passive. More snips based on stacks from auto attacks.

abilities.name: Hallowed Mist
abilities.summary: Create a mist zone; enemies outside can't target or hit you.
abilities.details: Gwen creates a zone of mist. While inside, she's untargetable by enemies outside the mist. The mist follows her once then stays in place.

abilities.name: Skip 'n Slash
abilities.summary: Dash and gain attack speed, range, and on-hit damage.
abilities.details: Gwen dashes and empowers her auto attacks with bonus range, attack speed, and magic damage on-hit. First attack on a champion refunds half the cooldown.

abilities.name: Needlework
abilities.summary: Fire needles up to 3 times; must hit an enemy to unlock next cast.
abilities.details: Gwen fires a needle, then can recast twice more (each cast fires more needles). Must hit an enemy with autos or abilities to unlock each recast.
